transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad almost every single day. It just feels like this heavy emptiness that I can't shake off, and it's been going on for about 10 months now.
Have you had any period of at least two months during these 10 months when you felt significantly better, or has it been present כמעט every day the whole time?

No, there hasn't been any break at all. It has been there constantly, every single day for the last ten months without any relief. I just feel so tired of carrying this heavy weight every waking moment.
